course.title: Machine Tools
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A machine tools retailer, demand for tools is 20,000 per month. Retailer incurs. a fixed order placement, transportation and receiving cost of \$120 each time an order for tools is placed with the manufacturer. Retailer incurs a holding cost of 20 percent. The manufacturer uses the following marginal unit discount pricing schedule.

content.value_html:
Order QuantityMarginal Unit Price
0-8,000$5.00
8,000-13,000$4.95
Over 13,000$4.92

content.value: Evaluate the number of tools that retailer manager should order in each lot,
